string.command.help.root:
Commands for Catalyst Graves

/grave find [player]: outputs the location of a grave
/grave restore [player]: gives the player items from their grave
/grave recover [player] retrieves a copy of a player's death snapshot
string.command.help.find:
Search for the player's last grave, and output the dimension + coordinates. This checks for an active grave and fails if one is not at the expected location.

If a grave is not present, consider using /recover to get a copy of the player's latest death snapshot
string.command.help.restore: Restores a player's active grave if they cannot recover it. This empties the active grave at their last death position, spits the items at their feet, and places a marker there the grave was previously. If this command fails, consider using /recover to get a copy of the player's last death snapshot
string.command.help.recover:
/grave recover [player]
Give a copy of the player's latest death snapshot in the form of a set of chests. This contains all the items that were not soulbound, as those are restore to the player upon respawning."
